title: One question. A week's content.
caption:
You probably answered a useful content idea on your last sales call.

Start with one question your customers actually ask. Give a clear answer, show an example, then turn that idea into a video, a carousel, and a short post.

Give each piece an owner, a due date, and a simple review process. When the lesson connects to your service, make the next step clear.

That's the kind of repeatable workflow I help business owners build through Samin's Content Systems.

Want to map it for your business? Bring one customer question and book a call with me:
https://calendly.com/samin-dde/lets-see-what-ai-can-do-for-you

slides.label: The opening
slides.headline:
One question.
A week's
content.
slides.pose: lounging at a simple pixel laptop, holding a small cream note with a single question mark; black headphones; relaxed pose; the note becomes the visual seed of the next slides
slides.alt: Dark opening slide: One question. A week's content. An orange pixel mascot sits beside a laptop and a question note.

slides.label: CAPTURE
slides.headline: Start with a real question.
slides.body: Write down one question buyers ask before they hire you.
slides.pose: holding a cream pixel notebook and pencil, listening attentively; a large rounded speech bubble above the notebook shows the sample buyer question
slides.bubble: Why isn't my content bringing inquiries?
slides.tip: Use their words. Then answer clearly.
slides.alt: Capture one buyer question. Example: Why isn't my content bringing inquiries? Use their words, then answer clearly.

slides.label: EXPLAIN
slides.headline: Give one useful answer.
slides.body: Explain the problem, show one example, and give one next step.
slides.pose: arranging three clean cream pixel note cards on a desk, each separate and legible with labels: Problem, Example, Next step; mascot is standing to the right of the cards as a helpful teacher
slides.tip: Teach one thing people can use today.
slides.alt: Structure one useful answer in three parts: Problem, Example, Next step. Teach one thing people can use today.

slides.label: REPURPOSE
slides.headline: Turn it into three posts.
slides.body: Film the answer. Turn the steps into a carousel. Pull one takeaway into a short post.
slides.pose: standing proudly beside three distinct large pixel content tiles: a video tile with a play symbol, a stacked carousel tile, and a short text tile; label them Video, Carousel, Short post
slides.tip: Same idea. A different way to learn.
slides.alt: Repurpose the answer into three posts: a Video, a Carousel, and a Short post. Same idea, a different way to learn.

slides.label: ORGANIZE
slides.headline: Make the workflow visible.
slides.body: Move each post through four stages. Give it one owner and a due date.
slides.pose: moving one orange card on a clean four-column cream workflow board; the columns read Draft, Review, Ready, Published; each column has one generic blank note card and no metrics, app logos or account data
slides.tip: Approve the content before it goes live.
slides.alt: A simple production board has four stages: Draft, Review, Ready, Published. Every post has an owner and a due date.

slides.label: INVITE
slides.headline: Make the invitation clear.
slides.body: Connect the lesson to your service. Invite interested readers to book a conversation.
slides.pose: pointing to three stepping-stone cards linked by fine orange hand-drawn arrows; labels in order Useful post, Inquiry, Booked call; one small cream pixel calendar and a question bubble; this is a conceptual path, no counts or performance graphs
slides.tip: Track inquiries and calls alongside views.
slides.alt: Make the next step clear: a useful post can lead to an inquiry and a booked call. Track inquiries and calls alongside views.

slides.label: YOUR NEXT STEP
slides.headline: Build your content system.
slides.body: Bring one customer question. We'll map how your expertise can become repeatable content.
slides.pose: confidently holding a large cream pixel calendar with a simple orange checkmark, standing beside a neat stack of content cards; friendly, grounded, no trophy or wealth symbols
slides.alt: Samin's Content Systems. Build your content system. Bring one customer question and book a call with Samin using the link in the caption.
